ARCH 500.description: A series of projects focusing on conceptual development, design synthesis, principles of typology, organization and representation. Corequisite: ARCH_V 502. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 501.description: Prerequisite: ARCH_V 500. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 503.course_name: Architecture and Society Through the Ages
ARCH 503.description: Key debates and questions in the field of architecture. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 504.description: History of architecture in the pre-1900 time period. Technological, political, social, and economic changes that have influenced architecture and related fields. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 505.description: History of architecture in the post-1900 time period. Technological, political, social, and economic changes which have influenced architecture and related fields. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 511.description: Architectural technology, including materials and methods, construction types, and building system integration. Strong emphasis on enclosure performance with focus on smaller buildings and light wood framing construction. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 512.description: Quantitative and qualitative means for understanding of statics, materials and flow of force through a structure. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 513.description: Building form and fabric considerations to assure appropriate thermal, luminous, sonic, and atmospheric conditions within buildings. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 515.description: Foundations of manual and digital skills and concepts employing a variety of subjects, techniques and software. Credit will be granted for only one of ARCH_V 515, DES_V 211 or ENDS_V 320. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 517.description: Intermediate manual and digital skills and concepts employing a variety of subjects, techniques and software. Credit will be granted for only one of ARCH_V 517, ARCH_V 437 or DES_V 212. Prerequisite: ARCH_V 515. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 520.description: Prerequisite: ARCH_V 501. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 521.description: Prerequisite: All of ARCH_V 511, ARCH_V 512, ARCH_V 513, ARCH_V 520. Corequisite: All of ARCH_V 531, ARCH_V 533. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 522.description: A seminar examining current issues in Architecture, based on reading assignments, papers and presentations. Enrolment is limited to facilitate discussion. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 523.description: Theoretical propositions and their built manifestations. Prerequisite: 6 credits of ARCH_V 504, ARCH_V 505. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 531.description: Analysis and design of advanced assemblies. Integration of multiple building systems within a wide range of construction types, and more complex enclosures in a variety of climatic conditions. Emphasis on technical performance, durability and sustainability. Prerequisite: ARCH_V 511. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 532.description: Complex multi-span and continuous systems: effective material configuration, approximate methods of analysis, selection of appropriate structural systems, earthquake configuration and high rises. Prerequisite: ARCH_V 512. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 533.description: Mechanical and electrical services of buildings and their integration with architectural form and fabric. Prerequisite: ARCH_V 513. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 537.description: Pass/Fail. Pre-approved studies in architecture in an international context. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 538.description: More than one section may be taken concurrently. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 539.description: Design studio component of term-long study abroad offering. Prerequisite: All of ARCH_V 500, ARCH_V 501. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 540.description: Prerequisite: ARCH_V 521. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 541.description: Ethical, legal and business context of professional practice, including contracts, project management. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 543.description: Topics across a range of practice related subject matter. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 544.description: An in-depth study of a selected topic in architecture. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 545.description: Directed research and exploration of selected topics in architecture. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 548.description: Preparation of a graduation design project including literature review. Prerequisite: All of ARCH_V 521, ARCH_V 523, ARCH_V 531, ARCH_V 532, ARCH_V 533. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 549.description: Design component, completion, and defense of the graduation design project. Honours/Pass/Fail. Prerequisite: ARCH_V 548 and no more than 18 credits outstanding beyond ARCH_V 549 This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 551.description: Understanding the role, composition, organization, and conventions of the formal documentation necessary for communication of an architectural design to those undertaking the construction. Prerequisite: All of ARCH_V 511, ARCH_V 512. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 555.description: Approved and supervised work experience in an established company or organization for a minimum of one academic term. Technical report required. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 561.description: Topics across a range of history/theory-based subject matter. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 571.description: Topics across a range of building material and construction technology-based subject matter. Prerequisite: All of ARCH_V 511, ARCH_V 512. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 572.course_name: Research Seminar: Advanced Structure and Generative Methods
ARCH 572.description: Structural principles and corresponding mathematical representation as three- and four-dimensional digital models using structural analysis software. Prerequisite: ARCH_V 512. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 573.description: An investigation of specialized environmental topics concerning theory and the practice of architecture. Prerequisite: ARCH_V 513. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 574.description: Enhanced building environmental performance and the integration of green building principles, strategies and technologies. Equivalency: HPB_V 501. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 575.description: The relationship between human and natural systems in the context of regenerative design. Provides an understanding of how regenerative approaches differ from green design and how they can offer new insights and directions for design. Equivalency: HPB_V 502 This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 577.description: Prerequisite: All of ARCH_V 515, ARCH_V 517. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 597.description: Individual or small group study of special topics. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

ARCH 598.description: Restricted to M.A.S.A. candidates. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
